description: This dataset contains ROV survey data collected on September 8, 2020, during a single marine research event identified as PS122/5_61-35. The records link twenty unique binary files, such as depth profiles and spectrums, to specific geospatial measurements. Each entry corresponds to a location at latitude 88.675993 and longitude 112.324519, with an elevation of -4291.4 meters, indicating deep-sea operations. The temporal resolution is daily, serving as a key for aggregating data across the survey. Researchers can utilize this dataset to analyze underwater environmental conditions, validate sensor telemetry, and study sea ice draft distributions in polar regions.
